decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the mobile classroom hereby permitted shall be in keeping with those used in the main school building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (PC-11-19/01, PC-11-19/02 and PC-11-19/03 received 20.05.11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Before occupation of the approved development, a minimum of 5% of each side of the base structure shall allow for ventilation of ground gas and shall be permanently retained for the duration of the use of the mobile classroom.

Condition : 5 - The building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 14.07.16 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of a new single mobile classroom unit.
